Part 3 (Modern Day)
They do not have your best interests at heart and never have.

Today the pattern is fully industrialized. Globalists push open borders mass migration H-1B programs and offshoring for the exact same reason their predecessors did centuries ago. Flooding the labor market drives down wages increases dependence and prevents ordinary citizens from building real prosperity at home.

Look at the remittance numbers. In 2025 India received over 125 billion dollars Mexico over 60 billion and the Philippines over 40 billion. These governments rely on exporting their citizens because they have failed to create enough good paying jobs domestically. A successful nation builds an economy where its own people can raise families without having to leave. Exporting your population to collect remittances is not development. It is a confession of failure.

Globalists share their ambitions and profits with the institutions that will forward their agendas. Weaken borders, kill culture, weaken governments, and replace the citizens who would stand in their way by giving the opportunities to DEI, then Foreigners, and eventually computers. 

Meanwhile here in the United States the same pressure keeps H-1B and similar programs alive so corporations can suppress wages and avoid training American workers. The machine has not changed. It has only scaled up and put on better branding.
The fight is the same one that began in the 1600s. Control distribution crush local labor and keep power in as few hands as possible.

If you see this long pattern in your own industry family history or community drop your observation in the comments. Like share and bookmark this thread if it connects the dots for you. Follow for more.

Sources (APA style):
World Bank. (2025). Migration and development brief 41. World Bank Group.
Economic Policy Institute. (2025). The China toll update. Economic Policy Institute.
Anderson S. (2026). Remittance flows to India Mexico and China reach record levels. Forbes.
Chisholm G. B. (1946). The psychiatry of enduring peace and social progress. Psychiatry 9(1) 1-20.
U.S. Senate. (1950). State Department Employee Loyalty Investigation [Report]. U.S. Government Printing Office.
World Economic Forum. (2024). Global Future Council on Migration: Annual report. World Economic Forum.
